scope: Primary-source inspection and short hands-on checks; not complete playthroughs, accessibility audits, or reproduction of the source implementations.

confidenceScale.high: Directly observed interaction or explicit primary documentation
confidenceScale.medium: Interpretation of documented controls; interaction not exercised
confidenceScale.low: Sparse or blocked page; limited claims only

works.title: Bicycle
works.entry: Move a slider and watch a small physical example; rotate the view where offered.
works.feedback: Force arrows, motion and speed measurements connect the control to its consequence.
works.progression: Build from simple forces and torque toward bicycle behavior.
works.failureLesson: Removing an applied force does not erase existing velocity; aggressive braking can tip the bicycle.
works.modelAndConfidence: Simplified examples explain assumptions; no model-confidence display was established.
works.checkpoint: Restart and time controls support local experiments; no persistent branch tree verified.
works.accessibility: Hands-on keyboard and reduced-motion behavior not tested.
documented: Interactive physical explanations and time controls

reuse.advice: Borrow teaching structure; implement original simulations.

works.title: Sound
works.entry: Play three notes, then investigate what air is doing.
works.feedback: Particle collisions, compression and plots turn sound into visible causes.
works.progression: Move from particles and pressure to oscillation and waves.
works.failureLesson: Extreme container motion is constrained to avoid an unhelpful simulation regime.
works.modelAndConfidence: The author explicitly simplifies particles and slows time; these are explanatory models.
works.checkpoint: Local controls; persistent branches not verified.
works.accessibility: Keyboard and touch note input documented; audio-volume guidance present; not personally tested.

reuse.advice: Use original visuals and sound code.

works.title: Introduction to A*
works.entry: Move map endpoints; compare how representations preserve a graph.
works.feedback: Paths and internal search state are spatially connected.
works.progression: Breadth-first search, costs, then goal-directed search.
works.failureLesson: A search only knows the graph supplied to it.
works.modelAndConfidence: Separates inputs, internal state and output; no probabilistic confidence implied.
works.checkpoint: Back/forward controls present. Historical 2014 notes describe recomputing cheap search for history; they predate the redesign.
works.accessibility: Native step buttons observed; no full keyboard audit.
observed: Clicked alternate map representation and inspected its connected graph

reuse.advice: Retain applicable notices; do not extend that statement to every site asset.

works.title: 2D Visibility
works.entry: Move the viewpoint and see what is visible.
works.feedback: The visible polygon changes with walls and observer position.
works.progression: Ray casting, endpoints, sweep internals, then a movable-block playground.
works.failureLesson: Numerical robustness problems are acknowledged rather than hidden.
works.modelAndConfidence: Displays the geometric mechanism; approximation limits are explicit.
works.checkpoint: Adjustable examples, no durable branching verified.

reuse.license: Apache-2.0 for linked Haxe source, per author
reuse.advice: Consider robust geometric predicates; do not treat pedagogical code as production geometry.

works.title: The Evolution of Trust
works.entry: Make a cooperate-or-cheat choice before studying strategies.
works.feedback: The payoff appears and is explained immediately.
works.progression: Single decisions grow into repeated games, tournaments, mistakes and a sandbox.
works.failureLesson: A losing choice creates the next explanation rather than an error screen.
works.modelAndConfidence: Explicit game rules; results are properties of a toy model, not calibrated predictions about people.
works.checkpoint: Chapter navigation and sandbox reset documented; branch history not verified.
works.accessibility: Muted sound successfully; a text click was intercepted by a pointer hitbox.
observed: Saw -1 versus +3 and the follow-up explanation

reuse.advice: Keep creator and asset attribution useful even where not required.

works.title: Parable of the Polygons
works.entry: Move shapes whose local neighborhood does not meet their rule.
works.feedback: Local rearrangement changes the population pattern.
works.progression: Manual moves become automated runs and adjustable rules.
works.failureLesson: Changing a preference after segregation need not undo the earlier outcome.
works.modelAndConfidence: A simplified social analogy with stated limits; no predictive confidence claim.
works.checkpoint: Initial conditions matter; matched-seed forks would be our addition.
works.accessibility: Drag mechanics documented; keyboard alternative not verified.

reuse.advice: Credit both creators and retain explicit model limitations.

works.title: Draw a Perfect Circle
works.status: browser blocked; primary page shell inspected
works.feedback: The primary shell shows a percentage result.
works.progression: A short retry loop is a design inference; detailed behavior was not verified.
works.failureLesson: No exact scoring formula or rejection thresholds established.
works.modelAndConfidence: A score is visible; its algorithm was not inspected.
works.accessibility: Not tested because of the block.
observed: Cloudflare 403 prevented the browser interaction; no bypass attempted

reuse.advice: Reference the concise invitation; do not infer or copy a scoring implementation.

works.title: Spend Bill Gates' Money
works.entry: Use buy/sell quantities against an enormous displayed budget.
works.feedback: Ordinary purchase controls make scale concrete; live arithmetic was not exercised.
works.progression: The catalog spans inexpensive goods to very large purchases.
works.failureLesson: Everyday intuition struggles across orders of magnitude.
works.modelAndConfidence: Treat the budget and prices as toy inputs, not current financial facts.
works.checkpoint: Quantity reversal is visible in the controls; saved branches not established.
documented: Budget, item prices, quantities, Buy and Sell controls

reuse.advice: Reimplement the interaction idea with original data and visuals.

works.title: A Friendly Introduction to Spring Physics
works.entry: Compare easing with a spring, then alter one parameter.
works.feedback: The moving mass and adjacent configuration reveal the same change.
works.progression: Mass, tension and friction lead into a combined sandbox.
works.failureLesson: Overshoot and slow settling become understandable parameters.
works.modelAndConfidence: Gravity is deliberately omitted; the model is an animation abstraction.
works.checkpoint: Parameter experimentation, not a branch tree.
works.accessibility: Keyboard/touch operation and motion caveats documented; ArrowRight changed the slider. A newsletter overlay appeared.
observed: Changed friction from 12 to 17.5 and saw the code update

reuse.advice: Implement independently with the app's existing motion library.

works.title: Why Momentum Really Works
works.entry: Inspect optimization trajectories while varying update parameters.
works.feedback: Oscillation and convergence connect equations to visible paths.
works.progression: Analyze a tractable quadratic model before extending intuition.
works.failureLesson: Unstable settings expose the mechanism instead of merely receiving a bad score.
works.modelAndConfidence: The scope of the mathematical model matters; it is not universal empirical validation.
works.checkpoint: Parameter comparison documented; persistent forks not verified.

reuse.license: Article text/diagrams CC-BY-2.0 with exceptions; repository CC-BY-4.0
reuse.advice: Check the specific artifact and its attribution instead of merging these licenses.

works.title: Seeing Theory: Basic Probability
works.entry: Flip one coin, then a batch.
works.feedback: Empirical frequencies sit beside the reference probabilities.
works.progression: Repeated samples lead toward expectation and variance.
works.failureLesson: Small samples visibly differ from the reference. An untouched variance display exposed NaN during this visit.
works.modelAndConfidence: Separates known distribution parameters from sampled outcomes.
works.checkpoint: Sampling controls; durable forks not verified.
works.accessibility: Button-like elements appeared as generic controls; no full audit. Batch control disabled during animation.

reuse.license: LICENSE says Apache-2.0; README asks against commercial visualization use
reuse.advice: Conflicting reuse guidance: use an original implementation or clarify before copying.

works.title: Markov Chains
works.entry: Watch state transitions, change their speed, then inspect the matrix.
works.feedback: Matrix values, state diagrams and sequences describe the same system.
works.progression: Small chains lead to an editable matrix playground.
works.failureLesson: Invalid matrices turn red until probability and shape requirements hold.
works.modelAndConfidence: Transition probabilities are model inputs, not confidence that the model describes reality.
works.checkpoint: Editable parameters; branch history not established.

reuse.advice: Build an original diagram and validator; do not rely on an unattributed fork.

works.title: Wayfinder
works.status: creator and publisher documentation inspected; not played
works.entry: Move through landscapes and collect poetic tokens.
works.feedback: Publisher descriptions connect exploration with emergent poetry.
works.progression: A short journey through distinct environments rather than a dashboard of settings.
works.failureLesson: No failure mechanic was personally established.
works.modelAndConfidence: An artistic generative system, not a scientific model-confidence example.
documented: Exploration and generative poetry, per creator and publisher

reuse.advice: Do not infer artwork or game licensing from the artist's separately licensed tools.

works.title: canvas-sketch
works.status: primary API and license inspected; not run
works.entry: Define setup and a render function; preview a sketch.
works.feedback: Time, frame and output dimensions are explicit render inputs.
works.progression: Develop, control playback, then export frames or print-resolution art.
works.failureLesson: Separate rendering and export concerns from the sketch's state.
works.modelAndConfidence: Tool architecture, not a confidence interface or automatic determinism guarantee.
works.checkpoint: Playback/export primitives help; complete state and randomness recording remain the app's responsibility.

reuse.advice: Retain notices; useful for export tooling, not required for the React prototype.

works.title: Bruno Simon's 2025 portfolio
works.entry: Click the car, then drive to explore the portfolio.
works.feedback: Steering and collisions produce immediate world motion.
works.progression: Spatial destinations and contextual interactions replace a flat link list.
works.modelAndConfidence: Physics is local; server features are separate. No AI-confidence display.
works.checkpoint: Respawn observed; rewind or deterministic replay not verified.
works.accessibility: Arrow-key driving worked. Two top-level icon buttons were unnamed in the snapshot; touch/gamepad controls are documented.
observed: Saw airborne motion and scattered scene objects
Pressed R and returned upright after a transition

reuse.advice: Copy architecture only where useful; physics timing still needs explicit replay design.

works.title: Harmony
works.entry: Choose a brush and draw directly on the canvas.
works.feedback: A WEB stroke accumulates fine connections under the pointer.
works.progression: A compact brush vocabulary produces varied marks without a tutorial.
works.failureLesson: Clear and further drawing support experimentation; undo behavior not established.
works.modelAndConfidence: Procedural rules amplify gestures; no AI model or confidence claim.
works.checkpoint: Save/Clear visible; stroke-history branching would be our addition.
works.accessibility: Native brush selector observed; drawing was pointer-operated, no keyboard substitute tested.
observed: Drew a looping stroke and inspected its connecting lines

reuse.advice: Use original brush code or comply with its license; Three.js licensing does not replace Harmony's.
